comment: Agent proposals (cause, edge record, whether the change looks intended) merged into annotations.template.json as `proposed`. Never a decision: the owner sets `decision` in annotations.json. Keys are annotation row ids.

R1:added:http.h1_header_timeout:<absent>.note: New knob SSE_H1_HEADER_TIMEOUT_MS (default 120 s; 0 or unparseable keep the default). No family sets it. Behaviour: idle keep-alive, headless and partial-head HTTP/1.1 connections are closed after 120 s; the platform edge's upstream pool idle is unmeasured (edge record #12's risk).

R1:added:cli.fork_debt_sweep_secs:<absen.note: New flag --fork-debt-sweep-secs / FORK_DEBT_SWEEP_SECS (default 300 s, floored at 1): the pause between circles of the fork-debt reconciler, which releases the source references that deleted forks still owe. No family sets it. rc.4 had no reconciler. No edge record names the setting.

R1:removed:cli.absorb_concurrency:6-><ab.commit: 99d5c098, then the commit of edge record #74
R1:removed:cli.absorb_concurrency:6-><ab.note: The three v1 absorber options are no longer declared. Inert on both sides: rc.4 set AbsorberConfig.{pass_bytes, small_pass_bytes, concurrency} and never read them; 99d5c098 (2026-09-13) made them Option, accepted and ignored with one warning; the commit of edge record #74 removed the fields, the arguments and the warning. The argument is refused on argv (clap UnknownArgument, exit 2); the environment name is not read.

R1:removed:cli.absorb_pass_bytes:2684354.commit: 99d5c098, then the commit of edge record #74

R1:removed:cli.absorb_small_bytes:104857.commit: 99d5c098, then the commit of edge record #74

R1:removed:scaler.cold_evals:180-><absen.note: SCALE_COLD_EVALS was parsed and logged and never read, at rc.4 too (the field of ScalePolicy had no reader). A stream merges after every segment stayed cold for hot_evals x 4 evaluations. No family sets the name. Scaler decisions are unchanged.

R1:removed:scaler.cold_pct:0.15-><absent.note: SCALE_COLD_PCT: see scaler.cold_evals. A segment is cold while every rate is below hot_pct x 0.05 of its limit.

R1:removed:scaler.max_segments:64-><abse.note: MAX_SEGMENTS_PER_STREAM: see scaler.cold_evals. No count of segments stops a split, on either side.

R2:NO_EFFECT_AT_VALUE:STREAMS_DEBUG_EXIT.note: Read by both sides (http.debug_exit = value == "1"); the family's 0 equals the unset default, so neither removal nor perturbation changes anything. Not a difference.

R2:NO_EFFECT_AT_VALUE:STREAMS_DEBUG_TIMI.note: Read by both sides (http.debug_timing = value == "1"); 0 equals the unset default. Not a difference.

R4:notice:gone:ABSORB_GLOBAL_BUDGET_BYTE.note: rc.4 warned when the default 64 MiB absorb budget was floored to one worst-case frame build (96.2 MiB). The floor still applies at HEAD: the resolved absorbBudgetBytes (/v1/debug/absorb) is 100859904 on both sides, and HEAD states it in the INFO 'memory budget' line. Only families without the compute-1g profile (defaults, platform-e2e) hit the floor. Removed by the R10 refactor on 2026-09-06, before the hardening program.
